title: Cartwise+ Membership Pause Terms
content:
Only some Cartwise+ Membership plans can be paused. The pause terms per plan are:

| Plan | Pause offered | Shortest pause (calendar days) | Longest pause (calendar days) | Pauses allowed in any rolling 365-day window | Request cutoff before the next renewal date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | yes | 14 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | yes | 14 | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | yes | 14 | 90 | 2 | 1 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

A value of 0 in the shortest-pause and longest-pause columns means the plan does not offer a pause.

## Points of reading

- The three monthly plans can be paused; the three annual plans cannot.
- Cartwise+ Monthly allows a longer pause (up to 90 days) than Cartwise+ Assist Monthly and Cartwise+ Student Monthly (up to 60 days each); all three share the 14-day shortest pause.
- The request cutoff is the minimum number of calendar days before the next renewal date by which a pause must be requested; for the monthly plans it is 1 day.
